title: Guide to Determining Impairment and Compensation 2026
version_kind: as made (no compilation is registered; the instrument is unamended)
converter: cth_convert_sym_v10.py (a copy of docx_text() of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font and private-use characters; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used docx_text() of workbench harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py: word/document.xml paragraphs one per line (table cells included, one per line), table-of-contents paragraphs dropped, Chapter/Part/Division headings as '\tPart N — Title'; images (formulas, figures) are not converted

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.previous_converter: harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (docx_text), the converter of the 2026-10-23 deposit
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word document of F2026L00595 (download_sha256 c51e753fd588aa977d2096e6f2e622d935488f73dea5f17d051432419b22251d, unchanged)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: The Guide types some list markers as text in the Symbol font, which docx_text() kept as raw private-use code points (U+F0xx) that display as empty boxes. cth_convert_sym_v10.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F0B7 •, F02D −, F0A8 ♦ and the like), maps Symbol-font w:sym elements the same way and Wingdings boxes to "[ ]"; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: A diff against the first deposit shows only these 620 lines changed (same 13,266 lines, same 395,746 characters), in each one private-use list marker replaced by its character: 576 bullets (U+F0B7 -> •, from line 203 onward), 39 sub-list dashes (U+F02D -> −: lines 400-402, 2571-2594, 3832-3855, 4440-4442, 7005-7016) and 5 diamond markers (U+F0A8 -> ♦: lines 135, 137, 160, 162, 164). No word or number changed. Not restored: the female, male and combined gender symbols after 'the symbol' (lines 160-165) are pictures (alternative text 'Venus (female) symbol', 'Mars (male) symbol', 'Combined male and female symbol'), which no converter of the deposit turns into text, like the Guide's other images.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: No encoding of this subject. military-rehabilitation-and-compensation-act-2004/encodings/baseline-2026-10 (mrca-guide.l4) reads Tables 23.1 and 23.2 (lines 11474-12900, unchanged) and the Chapter 23 formula in the sidecar; two changed lines (12912-12913, the bullets of 'Combined ratings') sit in the text it relies on, but only their markers changed, so no rule, case, value or finding changed. No encoding records the text hash; the formulas sidecar quotes no changed line.
